quizzes.question: Kavya needs 3,000 phones, 2,000 boxes and 1,000 audio devices. Which sequence is mix-leveled?
options: All phones, then all boxes, then all audio
One of each product, in turn
quizzes.explanation: The repeating pattern follows the 3 : 2 : 1 demand ratio. Big batches create peaks; equal quantities ignore the real mix.

quizzes.question: A customer suddenly wants 500 audio devices early. What should Kavya do FIRST?
options: Insert them in the very next slot
Check due dates, stock, parts and test capacity, then change the slots
Add overtime and build them all today
quizzes.explanation: Check the impact first, then change the next release slots using the agreed rules. Jumping the queue blindly, or refusing outright, both cause trouble.
